from build123d import *
t=4
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch():
        Polygon((0,0),(50,0),(0,50),align=None)
    extrude(amount=t)
    edges_v = p.edges().filter_by(Axis.Z)
    fillet(edges_v, 3)
    with Locations((50/3,50/3,t)):
        Hole(10)
result = p.part
